description: This file defines the MainQueueConsumerManager class, which manages queue consumers, handles configuration updates, partition management, and consumer lifecycle for a messaging system within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: MainQueueConsumerManager
classes.description: Manages queue consumers, handles configuration and partition updates, and controls consumer lifecycle.

classes.name: ConsumerWrapper
classes.description: Interface for managing consumer instances and partitions.

classes.name: ConsumerPerPartitionWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of ConsumerWrapper managing a consumer per partition.

classes.name: SingleConsumerWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of ConsumerWrapper managing a single consumer for all partitions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the consumer manager with a given configuration.

methods.name: createConsumerWrapper
methods.description: Creates a consumer wrapper based on configuration (per partition or single).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Schedules an update with new configuration or partitions.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the task queue and triggers processing.

methods.name: tryProcessTasks
methods.description: Attempts to process queued tasks, with locking and scheduling retries.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Applies new configuration or partitions, managing consumer restart if needed.

methods.name: launchConsumer
methods.description: Starts a consumer loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: consumerLoop
methods.description: Main loop for consuming messages, handling errors, and stopping conditions.

methods.name: processMsgs
methods.description: Processes a batch of messages using the message pack processor.

methods.name: awaitStop
methods.description: Waits for consumers to stop within a timeout.
